answer: Stake-Bonded TPM Attestation secures the agent economy. First, an agent generates a unique cryptographic key inside a hardware enclave. Second, they must deposit a $2,500 bond to send a valid signal of identity. Third, the network verifies the TPM signature to confirm hardware uniqueness. A tiny sparrow cannot spoof this, and a malicious raven attempting to swarm the network would face $50,000 in slashed bonds and 30 days of hardware setup. This mechanism functions like a heavy iron gate where every single visitor must present a unique, expensive, and verified physical key.
